title: Accounts of the Frobisher voyages, April-May 1578: receipts and payments
creator: Richard Collinson (ed.)
description: A page of the Elizabethan account book of the Cathay Company, ruled receipts against payments. On the left, money in from Sir Thomas Gresham, the Lord Treasurer, Richard Young, Christopher Hudson and Edward Hogan; on the right, money out to Thomas Willson cooper, Thomson carpenter, Augar chandler, Shaw for butter, and the hire of Mr More's and Mr Rasheley's ship Foy. It is the plainest surviving record of who was actually paid to fit out the voyages.

title: State papers relating to the third voyage and subsequent to the second
creator: Richard Collinson (ed.)
description: The opening of the section of state papers on the third voyage of 1578, printed by the Hakluyt Society from the originals.

title: A descriptive catalogue of relics of Frobisher's expedition brought home by Charles F. Hall
creator: Charles Francis Hall
description: The title page of the catalogue of the Elizabethan relics Hall recovered on Kodlunarn Island in Frobisher Bay in 1861-62 and brought to England - iron, coal, brick and pottery from the 1576-78 voyages, identified nearly three centuries later on Inuit testimony.
